description:
WODone turns the gym whiteboard into a training log you can talk to.

Upload a photo of the day's WOD and ChatGPT reads it, then WODone saves it as a structured record: workout type, movements with reps and loads, your score, and the original text exactly as written. Weights and distances are converted to consistent units, and movement names are normalized, so "T2B", "toes to bar", and "Toes-To-Bar" all land on the same movement in your history.

Ask for your records and WODone shows them newest first, or filters by date or movement — "show my thruster workouts from last week". Open one and you also see how you performed each of its movements before, so you can tell whether today was heavier or faster than last time.

Got something wrong? Tell WODone what to fix and it corrects the record, or delete it.

WODone never receives your photos — ChatGPT reads them and passes along only the text.

defaultPrompt: Log today's WOD: 21-15-9 thrusters at 95 lb and pull-ups, 8:42 Rx
Show my thruster workouts from the last month
Show my latest WOD in detail
